tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check mod.ts adapters tests tools examples
tasks.test: deno task setup && deno task setup:browser && deno test -A tests
tasks.bench: deno task setup && deno run -A tools/bench.ts && deno run -A tools/library-bench.ts
tasks.bench:library: deno task setup && deno run -A tools/library-bench.ts
tasks.bench:scene: deno task setup && deno run -A tools/scene-bench.ts after
tasks.bench:game: deno task setup && deno run -A tools/game-bench.ts
tasks.bench:gpu: deno task setup:browser && deno run -A tools/gpu-bench.ts
tasks.bench:compiler: deno task setup && deno run -A tools/compiler-probe.ts
tasks.capture: deno task setup:browser && deno run -A tools/capture.ts
tasks.example: deno task setup && deno run -A examples/run.ts
